_about: The News tab's free sources: one list for the engine (news.py) and the Mac app's News page (bundled by project.yml). Every feed is the publisher's own key-free RSS and links straight to the publisher's article page. On 2026-10-15 each was checked live: the feed answered with at least three stories, its newest under two weeks old, and at least four of five current stories were fetched through JOAT's own extractor with its honest user agent and read in full (120+ words, no paywall wording). news.py applies the same test to every story before listing it, and rests a feed that keeps failing, so a source whose pages later change stops being listed by itself. Sources marked default are on until the wearer changes the subject's sources. Left out on purpose: Google News (its links need JavaScript to reach the article), PBS NewsHour (its pages extract as one run-on block), News 9 (its article pages extract as a video hub, not the story), Reuters and AP (no working feeds), metered and hard paywalls (New Scientist, MIT Technology Review, Nature, The Hindu, Globe and Mail, Irish Times, LA Times, Straits Times, Business Insider, Quartz, Sifted, Fortune, MIT Sloan Management Review), CNN (its feed is http only), and feeds that did not read in full at least four times in five: Al Jazeera, NPR World and National, CBS World, BBC Health, KOCO, the Guardian science feed, and the Phys.org family (it refuses automated readers).
